{{Top|leg}}
The '''Yularen family''' was an influential family of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Notable members included [[Thull Yularen]], an instructor at the [[Anaxes Citadel]], and [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], a Republic [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] who went on to serve the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The family possessed an [[Yularen estate|estate]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]]. At some point, the Yularen family, under unknown circumstances, managed to include the ''[[Letter from Christophsis]]'', a letter between then-Jedi Apprentice [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]] detailing a first-hand account of the battle, among their documents.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
